description:
Revised design authorized by the user after rejecting hardcoded history flags. This description supersedes the original fixed-false history requirements and historical completion comments. Preserve useful completed reply-policy work and RAM enforcement; rework the history configuration ownership and validate the composed result.
Rework ../jido_chat_whatsapp/lib/jido_chat_whatsapp/adapter.ex and focused package tests/docs. Replace unconditional false overwrites in BOTH saved-binding and trusted connection_options preparation. Read history options from existing ingress; explicit true and false must survive preparation and reach listener configuration. Define precedence: explicit ingress flags, then supported trusted connection history values, then documented prepared-path false fallback. Never use truthiness fallback that drops false. Accept only booleans; reject explicit invalid/null flag values with a stable error. Do not forward arbitrary persisted profile, storage or config overrides. Preserve authenticated identity/storage selection, sink_mfa, callback shapes and error propagation. Keep provider_child_specs strict RAM behavior and raw Mnesia configurability. Preserve lower-level listener compatibility.

Tests: both flags independently true/false and combinations; omission/fallback; invalid types; string-key persisted ingress; saved and trusted startup; tampered profile/storage protection; unavailable binding/storage errors; RAM success/disk rejection. Revise the new connection_defaults test that wrongly expects supplied true to be overwritten, keeping its independent safety assertions. No new callback/MFA/core change.

Required policies: AGENTS.md; docs/agent-tools.md; docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md;
docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md; docs/action-reuse.md; docs/testing-approach.md;
docs/services/channels.md. Read sibling AGENTS.md before sibling changes, Engine
guide before persistence work, and documentation hygiene before updating docs.
Read system-config guidance if touching encrypted fields (which should be avoided).
Preserve existing assertions. Obtain explicit approval before changing existing test
behavior; add focused tests first. No UI feature/E2E work is required by this refactor.
Commit, push, publishing dependency revisions, and merge require separate authorization.

Both startup paths covered across all flag combinations plus invalid values. Package mix q passes (package alias checks formatting, so package formatter ran first); whole non-live suite passes 200 tests + 12 properties, 13 live excluded.
